backup.title: Backup
backup.hint: Save favorites, caught shinies and teams to a JSON file, to restore them on another device or after reinstalling. Importing replaces the current data.

errors.invalid: The file isn't a valid backup.
errors.otherApp: The file isn't a backup of this app.
errors.newerVersion: The backup was created by a newer version of the app.
